note: Mon 9/21 AM refresh after Sunday: Hutchinson and Hollins move from pursue to watch (Hutchinson turned nine targets into 37 yards with Collins out; Hollins led New England in snaps but saw two targets). Tank Bigsby and Emanuel Wilson come on as handcuff pursues (Barkley MRI Monday, Price X-rays negative). Demarcus Robinson comes off: Sleeper lists him Out and I have no source to explain it. Bryce Young, Shough and Bagent are avoids for me but contested by mfkr (Williams) and pauldag (Daniels). No empty starting slot. Two pursues commit 9 of 88 FAAB.

targets.hook: Barkley (stinger, MRI Mon) handcuff: 13 carries Sun
targets.why: Barkley left with a stinger on the opening drive, returned for the second half and had four carries for nine yards; Bigsby logged 26 snaps and 15 opportunities (13 carries, 2 targets) for 41 yards and a touchdown (Roto Street Journal 2026-09-20, NBC Sports 2026-09-20). Sirianni said Monday it was 'still early in the day' and no MRI result has been announced; Dallas Goedert also has a knee MRI pending (NBC Sports 2026-09-21). Philadelphia visits Chicago Sept. 28.
targets.asset: Primary backup in a run-first offense; a full-workload back only if Barkley misses time, otherwise a bench handcuff.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 2, one game as the fill-in)
targets.my_team_impact: Would not start ahead of Jonathan Taylor, Jeanty, Irving or Tuten; a handcuff to a rostered back is a bench piece whose upside is a lineup spot for as long as Barkley is out. Boutte (Houston depth) is the softest bench spot to open.
targets.confidence_why: One game as the fill-in and the whole case rests on an MRI I do not have the result of; a clean scan makes him a bench handcuff again.
targets.competition: DiaperDutyDaddy owns Barkley and is the obvious owner to protect him; a Bigsby claim is the most direct hedge on the league.
targets.bid: 6 dollars, inside the 8-12 contested_routine band because the role is contingent. DiaperDutyDaddy is the rival most likely to bid, so I would not go lower.
targets.drop: Boutte is a Houston depth WR behind Collins, Hutchinson and Schultz; not a startable piece for me.

targets.hook: 21 carries, 92 yds after Price left with a chest injury
targets.why: Wilson led Seattle in rushing with 21 carries for 92 yards in the 31-7 win at Arizona once rookie Jadarian Price left with a chest injury after 13 carries for 52 yards (NBC Sports 2026-09-20). Mike Macdonald said X-rays on Price came back negative (Seahawks.com/SI 2026-09-20), so Price may be back.
targets.asset: Lead-back volume when Price is out and a change-of-pace role when he is healthy; a handcuff, not a standalone starter.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 2, one game with Price out)
targets.my_team_impact: Not a starter for me; Wilson is a handcuff to Price and a lead back if Price sits, which slots ahead of Johnston on my bench in a league with only five bench spots.
targets.confidence_why: Price's X-rays were negative, so Wilson goes back to a change-of-pace role if he is healthy; the 21 carries were the injury-driven game, one week of data.
targets.competition: Price is rostered across the HBGBs, so the natural handcuff bidder is his owner; I found no rival with a Seattle-shaped hole, and it clears at the routine band.
targets.bid: 3 dollars, in the 1-3 routine_uncontested band, because the value is contingent on a healthy Price staying healthy or not.
targets.drop: Johnston (LAC WR) is the second-softest bench piece behind Boutte; drop only if the Bigsby claim is not also going through.

targets.hook: Collins not expected back Week 3; 9 targets Sunday
targets.why: With Nico Collins out, Hutchinson caught 3 of 9 targets for 37 yards in a 20-6 loss to Cincinnati (NBC Sports 2026-09-20); Dalton Schultz drew 14 targets. Houston is also without Jayden Higgins (torn ACL) and Jaylin Noel had no catches on two targets. Collins's Grade 1 hamstring was not believed serious (ESPN 2026-09-19), but DeMeco Ryans gave no timeline Monday and the report is that Collins is not currently expected to play Week 3 against Indianapolis (The Big Lead 2026-09-21).
targets.asset: Top perimeter target while Collins is out, with the volume real and the efficiency poor; falls back to a WR3 role once Collins returns.
targets.my_team_impact: Would not crack my lineup with Pickens and Egbuka as the two WRs; his value is as a Collins contingency, and Stipe is the one who owns Collins.
targets.confidence_why: Nine targets and only 37 yards is a volume bump tied to an injury that is not expected to last.
targets.competition: Stipe owns Collins and Dalton Schultz is already rostered, so the Texans hedge is his to make.

targets.hook: Led NE WRs in snaps (50) but only 2 targets Sun
targets.why: With A.J. Brown on injured reserve, Hollins led New England receivers with 50 snaps in the 20-3 win over Pittsburgh but saw two targets for two catches and 18 yards (NBC Sports 2026-09-20, Patriots snap counts). Week 1 was four catches for 51 yards on a 70% snap share (Yahoo Sports 2026-09-18). Brown is out until about Week 6 and Romeo Doubs and DeMario Douglas share the work.
targets.asset: Every-down snaps with a thin target share; the role is real and the volume is not yet.
targets.my_team_impact: Does not beat Egbuka or Pickens for a slot, and two targets is a poor return for a 50-snap role; Boutte and Johnston are the pieces he would replace.
targets.confidence_why: A full snap share with two targets is a role without the production; Week 3 says whether Maye looks his way.
targets.competition: pauldag owns A.J. Brown and has the most reason to look at New England receivers.

targets.hook: 12 targets (29%), 46 snaps; Omar Cooper Jr. on IR
targets.why: Mitchell led the Jets with 12 targets (six catches, 63 yards, a 29% share of 41 attempts) and 46 snaps, second among receivers, in the 20-17 loss to Green Bay, with rookie Omar Cooper Jr. headed to injured reserve for at least four games (CBS Sports/NBC Sports 2026-09-20).
targets.asset: Full-time role and the team's target leader; the ceiling is set by the Jets' offense.
targets.my_team_impact: Would not start ahead of Pickens or Egbuka; a WR3 depth piece with a real target share.
targets.confidence_why: One game of 12 targets on a Jets offense that scored 17.
targets.competition: No rival has an obvious Jets-shaped hole.

targets.hook: 6 catches, 63 yds; Moore (AC sprain) is day-to-day
targets.why: Coleman had six catches for 63 yards on about a 60% route rate and a 19% target share while D.J. Moore left the Bills' Thursday win with an AC joint sprain and is day-to-day for Week 3 against the Chargers (Roto Street Journal 2026-09-20, NFL.com 2026-09-18).
targets.asset: Second option in a strong Buffalo offense whose role grows only if Moore misses time; owned in under 2% of leagues on RSJ.
targets.my_team_impact: No fit in my lineup; the case is Moore, who DiaperDutyDaddy owns, missing Week 3.
targets.confidence_why: His volume rises only if Moore sits, and Moore's status is up in the air.
targets.competition: DiaperDutyDaddy owns Moore and is the one with a reason to add his backup.

targets.hook: Handcuff with Harvey and Dobbins both hamstring-hurt
targets.why: The Denver rookie ran 10 times for 39 yards and a touchdown and caught 3 of 3 targets for 19 yards after J.K. Dobbins hurt a hamstring, with R.J. Harvey also out with a hamstring (SI, Roto Street Journal 2026-09-20). If either back misses Week 3 against the Rams, Coleman is the lead carrier.
targets.asset: Handcuff with a real role in one game; a stash for the injury.
targets.my_team_impact: A Denver handcuff has no path into my lineup; a stash only if a bench spot is free.
targets.confidence_why: One game with two hamstring injuries in front of him; the injuries decide the role.
targets.competition: Harvey is owned by bwalsh89, who would be the natural handcuff bidder.

targets.hook: Slot WR if Nacua sits Monday; Whittington doubtful
targets.why: Puka Nacua is questionable with groin soreness and ESPN's Adam Schefter has him more likely out than in for Monday night against the Giants; Jordan Whittington (quad) is doubtful. Mumpfield had a 63.6% slot rate in Week 1 (Rams.com 2026-09-19, SI 2026-09-20). I did not find a Week 2 target line for him this run.
targets.asset: Slot depth that turns into real volume only if Nacua misses time; Monday night settles it.
targets.rate_basis: projection (contingent on Nacua, one week of snaps)
targets.my_team_impact: No fit; the point is the Monday night result. If Nacua is out, Davante Adams is the beneficiary and Mumpfield a thin slot piece.
targets.confidence_why: Everything depends on Monday night's inactive list, which has not posted.
targets.competition: bwalsh89 owns Nacua and Stipe owns Adams; neither is hurt by the claim.

targets.hook: TD plays of 46 and 55 yds in two weeks; 23% share Wk 2
targets.why: Boston has scored on a 46-yard play in Week 1 and a 55-yard play in Week 2 with target shares of 18% and 23% (Roto Street Journal 2026-09-20). Volume is the open question.
targets.asset: Explosive plays on modest volume; more boom than base.
targets.confidence_why: Two long touchdowns are the whole case; the volume is modest.
targets.competition: No rival roster has a Browns-WR-shaped hole.

targets.hook: Rookie played 55 snaps (3 in Wk 1) with Pittman out
targets.why: The second-round rookie went from three snaps in Week 1 to 55 in Week 2 with Michael Pittman out, tying Roman Wilson for the second-most snaps among Pittsburgh receivers, and posted more yards on fewer targets than DK Metcalf (Behind the Steel Curtain/Yahoo Sports 2026-09-20).
targets.asset: Rookie in a bigger role whose next-week snaps depend on Pittman's foot.
targets.confidence_why: A jump from three snaps to 55 tied to one absence.
targets.competition: No rival roster has a Steelers-WR-shaped hole.

targets.hook: 5-for-5 on 32 routes; Bears WR pool thin
targets.why: Raymond caught 5 of 5 targets for 40 yards and ran 32 routes, second on the Bears, through two weeks with 13 catches against 14 combined for Rome Odunze, Luther Burden and Colston Loveland (Roto Street Journal, SI 2026-09-20). Chicago scored three points.
targets.asset: Reliable target in a passing game that is about to change quarterbacks.
targets.my_team_impact: No fit; the more relevant fact for me is Rome Odunze, who is on my bench and is competing for the same Bears target pool.
targets.confidence_why: A good target rate on an offense about to change quarterbacks.
targets.competition: mfkr owns Williams, so his Bears passing game is the one most exposed.

targets.hook: Led Dolphins with 23 routes; WR1 in snaps
targets.why: Washington led Miami receivers with 23 routes in Week 2 and is the team's WR1 in snaps, with a bigger role if Caleb Douglas (ankle) is sidelined (SI 2026-09-20).
targets.asset: Full-time snaps in a low-scoring offense.
targets.my_team_impact: No fit; Caleb Douglas (my bench, ankle) is the piece he would compete with in Miami.
targets.confidence_why: A snap-share role in an offense that has not scored.
targets.competition: No rival roster has a Dolphins-WR-shaped hole.

targets.hook: 55 snaps but 1 catch, 28 yds with Pittman out
targets.why: Wilson and rookie Germie Bernard both played 55 snaps in the 20-3 loss to New England with Michael Pittman out, but Wilson caught one pass for 28 yards on short targets (NBC Sports 2026-09-20).
targets.asset: Snap-share WR2 on a struggling offense; usage is there and production is not.
targets.confidence_why: One catch on a big snap share is a role without production.
targets.competition: No rival roster has a Steelers-WR-shaped hole.

targets.hook: 648 yds, 6 TD in two games; QB-hurt rivals will bid
targets.why: Young threw for 287 yards and three touchdowns in the 34-3 win over Atlanta and has 648 yards, 6 touchdowns and one interception through two weeks, tied for the league lead in touchdown passes (SI 2026-09-20). New OC Brad Idzik has him at 37 and 36 attempts, and the offense has cleared 340 yards and 30 points twice (Roto Street Journal 2026-09-20).
targets.asset: Startable QB on volume and a 4-point passing touchdown; the case is two real games, with a rushing element that is a small bonus.
targets.my_team_impact: No fit; Patrick Mahomes is my QB and there is no lineup slot for a second.
targets.confidence_why: The production is real over two weeks, but I have no use for it and rivals will bid.
targets.competition: mfkr (Williams hurt) and pauldag (Daniels dislocated his elbow) both have a QB hole and are the obvious bidders.

targets.hook: Leads NFL with 662 pass yds through two weeks
targets.why: Shough leads the league with 662 passing yards through two weeks against Detroit and Baltimore, about 300 a game (SI 2026-09-20), and faces Las Vegas in Week 3 (FantasyPros 2026-09-20).
targets.asset: Fast-paced Saints offense with real volume; a two-week sample.
targets.my_team_impact: No fit; same as Young, I have Mahomes.
targets.confidence_why: Real two-week volume but no need on my roster.
targets.competition: mfkr and pauldag both need a QB now and are the likely bidders.

targets.hook: Williams week-to-week; Bagent likely starts Week 3
targets.why: Ben Johnson said Monday the hamstring is 'week-to-week' and Williams 'will likely miss some time'; reports say the MRI showed a strain with no tear (NBC Sports/PFT 2026-09-21, OutKick 2026-09-21). Bagent, who started four games as a rookie in 2023, replaced him and would start Monday night, Sept. 28, against Philadelphia.
targets.asset: Depth-chart insurance behind a scoring-starved Bears offense; no track record to project from.
targets.rate_basis: projection (no snaps of note; a contingency read)
targets.my_team_impact: No fit; a backup with no track record.
targets.confidence_why: Everything hinges on an MRI result I do not have.
targets.competition: mfkr owns Williams and may hedge with his backup.

targets.hook: Trending K add; a streamer, not a need
targets.why: McLaughlin is among the most-added players in Sleeper (154k adds) on the strength of Tampa's offense; nothing else was verified this run.
targets.asset: A kicker on an offense that reaches field-goal range; the marginal gain over a rostered kicker is small.
targets.rate_basis: projection (job note, not a weekly trend)
targets.my_team_impact: Will Reichard is my kicker and there is no upgrade case that justifies FAAB.
targets.confidence_why: A kicker is the last place to spend FAAB.
targets.competition: Nobody is shopping for a kicker.

targets.hook: 2 TDs from Young; Ja'Tavion Sanders out
targets.why: Waller, 34, signed Aug. 13 and caught three passes for 33 yards and two touchdowns (12 and 7 yards) in the 34-3 win over Atlanta (Live5News/AP 2026-09-20). Ja'Tavion Sanders is listed out.
targets.asset: Touchdown-dependent tight end on a hot offense; the yardage is small.
targets.my_team_impact: No fit; Sam LaPorta starts and Jake Ferguson is on my bench.
targets.confidence_why: Two touchdowns on three catches is not a repeatable base.
